plan.notes: Source: official Maricopa pathway-map page (https://www.riosalado.edu/degrees-certificates/education/associate-science-emphasis-secondary-education-8609-as). Effective Term Fall 2026; catalog_year 2026-2027 derived from Effective Term. Full-time 'sequence of suggested courses' used; Rio Salado/Scottsdale are online/rolling-start so terms are numbered Term 1..N (no Fall/Spring labels). Sequence reflects the page's DEFAULT base pathway-map view (option-specific rows are hidden until a pathway option is selected). Credit ranges (e.g. '1-3') use the lower bound, per collection convention; 'X or Y' choices use the first-listed option's credits. Category mapping: core = AGEC/program area value present; major = no area value; elective = restricted/general-elective placeholders. Choices flagged choice=true. Coordinator remediation 2026-10-01 (source-verified mechanical fixes; see merge/REMEDIATION-LOG.md).
